            - Established telecommunication between station cell-modem  
              and data-collection PC/server on campus.    
 
 
07/13/2016: Station Setup                                                [1505] 
 
            - Loaded MAWN Program:   KWS-CBCB 
                                      KWS => Station ID (Kewaunee / Stangelville) 
                                        C => CR1000/WI (Logger/State) 
                                        B => CS616 (Soil Moisture) 
                                        C => HMP155A (Temp/RH) 
                                        B => LWS-L (Leaf Wetness) 
 
            - Now able to collect raw weather data.
